results.correct_value: Park about 1.2 mi back DOWN the road (toward Dayton) from the Middle Point Ridge Trailhead, at the Spangler Creek dirt-road junction — the approach text is right; the TRAILHEAD card's '1.5 miles above' is the crag-wide Dikes figure
results.evidence: The original Dikes guide says to turn around at the Middle Point Ridge trailhead, drive 0.6 mi until the Castle is visible and another 0.6 mi to park at the Spangler Creek dirt road; the Castle area page repeats that text verbatim, so it counts once. The route listing itself only says to park on the side of the road. No independent second description of the Castle parking was found. What would settle it: a separate trip report or map placing the Spangler Creek junction ~1.2 mi below the trailhead.

results.fact: Commitment grade for a 40 ft sport pitch
results.evidence: A commitment grade rates the whole outing, not the pitch; the route's published listing gives it Sport, 40 ft, Grade II, and the approach is a long, very steep bushwhack up a hillside with a terrible approach, so a single short pitch and grade II describe different quantities rather than conflict.
